name: rosetta-search-a-list
code:
use default

let haystack =
    ["zero", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight"]

position(needle: string) -> int? is
    let hit = haystack |> index() |> find(entry => entry.value =~ needle)

    if hit? then
        return hit.index
    fi

    return null
si

for needle in ["five", "dog"] do
    if let at = position(needle) then
        write_line("{needle} is at index {at}")
    else
        write_line("{needle} is not in the list")
    fi
